function: Excluded (above_phy): MADDPG agents learn each vehicle's offloading and local CPU power for vehicular edge computing task offloading (power and buffer length); RIS phase shifts come from classical BCD (p. 1, p. 3).
notes: Reason above_phy: the learning makes edge computing decisions. p. 1: "modified multiagent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) approach to optimize the power allocation for vehicle users (VUs) and block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm to optimize the phase-shift of the RIS"; p. 3: action "ak(t) = [pk,o(t), pk,l(t)]", objective "minimize the power consumption of task offloading and local processing as well as buffer length". The only area-3 decision, the RIS phase shift, is set by BCD (p. 3: "we use the BCD algorithm to obtain the optimal phase-shift"). If the reviewer counts the offloading transmit power as a physical-layer decision learned jointly with the computing one, the reason becomes function, since terrestrial user power allocation is not one of the seven areas. Pages 4-5 read from the page images (figure text garbled). PDF title and authors match the DOI (Crossref).
